summary: Ran full pytest suite (21 tests) against admin auth, OTP flow, and admin CRUD; 20 passed initially and 1 failed with 500 on GET /api/admin/users due to a legacy pre-schema user without role/status fields in MongoDB (deleted during test). Frontend admin flow validated end-to-end on 375x667 mobile viewport: admin login → dashboard stats (0/0/0/0, 4 models, 4 active) → nav to Requests/Users/Models → sign out → user OTP request via delivered@resend.dev → wrong-OTP error surfaced. Deprecated shadow* style warning present but non-blocking.

critical.issue: 500 KeyError: 'role' when a legacy user document without role/status exists in the users collection (leftover from a previous iteration schema). user_out() serializer assumes required keys. Reproduced: qa.anatomy@example.com existed with only email set. Cleaned up during testing.

minor.issue: 'users.total' filters role='user' only, so the seed admin is not counted. Product spec listed Users=1 in stats; endpoint returns 0. If intentional, ignore; otherwise include admins or rename label.

issues: Deprecated 'shadow*' RN style warning surfaces in web console; migrate to 'boxShadow' per RN 0.76+.

react_native_issues.issue: 'shadow*' style props are deprecated; use 'boxShadow'. Reference: /app/frontend/app/index.tsx shadow* usages (authPanel, segmentActive, organCard, backButton, etc.)

action_items: Harden GET /api/admin/users (and any find_one → user_out path) to tolerate legacy documents by either (a) migrating/removing legacy users on startup, or (b) using doc.get() with sensible defaults in user_out() and filtering out docs missing required fields.
Add an admin-panel back-to-gallery/back-to-auth safety and consider counting admin in 'All users' or rename the label to 'Active user accounts' to match backend filter.
Migrate deprecated 'shadow*' React Native style props to 'boxShadow' in /app/frontend/app/index.tsx (and any admin styles) to remove console warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py load_dotenv + os.environ[...] at import time is correct; JWT_SECRET is committed placeholder — main agent should rotate before prod.
user_out() requires role/status/created_at; any legacy or malformed document will 500 the listing endpoint. Consider using .get() with defaults and skipping malformed docs.
OTP hashing uses bcrypt (10 rounds default) — fine; delete on success and on expiry both implemented.
server.py is 695 lines — approaching size limit; consider splitting auth/admin/models routers into modules if it grows further.
seed_data_creation: Removed one legacy user (qa.anatomy@example.com) missing role/status from previous iteration to unblock GET /api/admin/users. Tests create+cleanup transient users/otps.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend base URL is EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. Seed admin: physicsproject@gmail.com / Air@123. For OTP end-to-end tests, insert a bcrypt-hashed code directly into db.otps ({email, code_hash, expires_at ISO, attempts, created_at}). Frontend testIDs: auth-user-toggle, auth-admin-toggle, admin-email-input, admin-password-input, admin-login-submit, user-email-input, request-access-submit, otp-input, verify-otp-submit, admin-sign-out, admin-tab-{dashboard|requests|users|models}, stat-{pending|approved|rejected|total|models|active-models}. Mobile viewport 375x667.
rca_of_issue: GET /api/admin/users 500 root cause: db.users.find({}) returns *all* documents including a legacy record (qa.anatomy@example.com) that predates the current schema and has no 'role'/'status' fields. user_out() then raises KeyError('role'). Mitigation applied in this run: deleted the legacy doc. Permanent fix (main agent): make user_out() defensive with doc.get('role','user') / doc.get('status','pending') defaults, or filter query to {'role': {'$exists': True}} and add a startup migration that patches or purges malformed users.
